summary: This clinical trial compares two different treatments for people with type 2 diabetes. The study looks at Mulberry Twig Alkaloid Tablets and Canagliflozin over a period of 12 weeks. Adults between the ages of 18 and 75 who have type 2 diabetes are able to take part in this research. The trial has an enrollment of 60 participants.

facts.sponsor: Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University
